name: video_background
title: Video Background
description: Muted, autoplaying background video for any container (hero, section, card): cover fit, optional segment (start / end seconds), loop or play once, optional sound with a mute toggle, tint overlay that follows light / dark mode, poster image, pauses when off screen and respects reduced motion. Also works on any HTML element through data-video-bg attributes (see video_background.js).
